name: my-demo
_comment: Same schema as the Playwright tool's flow.json, minus storageState/headless/outDir (this player runs in your own logged-in tab and downloads via chrome.downloads, so none of those apply). Only the FIRST step may be a goto — after that, stay on the same page and drive it with in-app clicks, since a full-page navigation reloads the tab and drops the injected content script. Replace baseUrl and every selector below with real ones from your app.
